invalid_slots.purpose: Invalid slots are recorded separately from the archived jobs, so that an infrastructure or quota failure is never silently read as a 0 capability score and never enters the discrimination statistics.
invalid_slots.immutability_note: The archived jobs tree is not rewritten. Every result.json, reward and log stays byte-for-byte as produced by the run; this file is an annotation layer on top of them.

invalid_criteria: The trial's agent_result status is not 'completed', or
The final/error text is a provider-side transport or quota failure (HTTP 429, AccountQuotaExceeded, HTTP 5xx, timeout), or
The verifier never ran on a candidate revision.
replacement_policy: An invalid slot keeps its planned slot (same model alias, one trial per planned slot, same ordering), so a replacement never adds extra weight to a model.
A replacement is attempted only for transport/quota/timeout failures; an environment defect of our own is fixed first and then the whole slot re-runs.

invalid_slots.policy: references/11-latest-qc-requirements.md §2：提供商侧的配额/限流/传输故障判为无效槽位，不得计入算法能力；无效槽位只做注解层表达，原始 result.json / exception.txt / trial.log 保持逐字节原样；替代轮绑定同一计划槽位（同 alias、同计划顺序、每槽位一轮），不给任何模型额外加权。

attempts.provider_message: 预扣费额度失败, 用户剩余额度: ¥0.075214, 需要预扣费额度: ¥0.094598

attempts.note: 绑定同一槽位重跑，但旧失败 job 目录仍在，Harbor 复用了同名 trial（request id 与原始轮逐字相同），未真正发起新调用；归档旧 job 后重跑解决。
归档旧失败 job 后以新 trial 重跑，端点返回 HTTP 200；该轮产生了完整的 agent 轨迹与 verifier 结果。

slots.resolution: 第 3 次尝试（replacement-2）以新 trial 成功，Opus 三次计划槽位现均为 VALID，替代轮未获得任何额外加权（仍为每槽位一轮）。
slots.impact: 已解除：validate_model_gate 的 REQUIRED_COUNTS={"qwen":3,"opus":3} 全部满足。

invalid_slot_summary.note: 两次无效尝试均属提供商配额故障（HTTP 403 预扣费额度不足），且第二次是同名 trial 复用导致的伪重跑；归档旧 job 后第三次尝试成功。归档树中原始失败证据已移入 invalid-slots-archive/ 逐字节保留。
